BALUCHISTAN WORKERS' CHILDREN EDUCATION CESS (UTILIZATION) RULES, 1984
BALUCHISTAN WORKERS' CHILDREN
EDUCATION CESS (UTILIZATION) RULES, 1984
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, No. 41, Jan.
31, 1984, P.1.]
No: 1‑83/79‑Labour.‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 6 of the Workers' Children
(Education) Ordinance 1972 (X1 of 1972), the Government of Baluchistan is
pleased to make the following Rules, namely :‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) These
rules may be called the Baluchistan Workers' Children Education. Cess
(Utilization) Rules, 1984.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. "Definitions."‑(1) In these
rules, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall
have the meanings hereby respec tively assigned. to them, that is to say :‑‑
(a) "Board" means the 'Baluchistan ,Provincial
Board of Management constituted under rule 3 of these rules ;
(b) "Committee". means Scholarship committees or
a committee appointed by the Board for finance or any other objective ;
(c) "Cess" means the cess payable under the said
Ordinance ,
(d) "Chairman" means Chairman of the Board.
(e) "Education" means and‑ includes all
types of . education whether general; vocational, technical or professional
imparted, taught and given in a recognised School, College, University or any
other institution provided by giving a scholarship or stipend or‑other
facilities such as text books, uniform, stationery, fees and funds payable to
the institution or hostel and combination of more than one of these facilities
and any other facilities connected with or inoidental to the objectives under
the Ordinance which the Government of Baluchistan may deem necessary for the
purposes of the said Ordinance ;
(f) "Form" means form appended to these rules ;
(g) "Government" means the Government of
Baluchistan ;
(h) "Member" means a member of the Board ;
(i) "Non‑official member" means member
other than official member ;
(j) "Official member" means a member who is in
service of Govern ment ;
(k) "Ordinance" means the Workers' Children (Education)
Ordi nance, 1972 (XI of 1972) ;
(l) "Scholarship" Means and includes any
financial aid to be given on monthly basis or otherwise to a student/child of
the worker for such a period as the Board may deem fit ; ,
(m) "Stipend" includes any assistance, facility
and benefit in the shape of cash or text‑book, stationery, uniform etc.
to be given or provided for a, student/child of the workers or payment of fees,
fund and dues payable by him to any institution or hostel in which he is,
pursuing his studies or lodges for this purpose.
2. All expressions used but not defined in these rules
shall have the meanings respectively assigned to them by Workers' Children
(Education) Ordinance, 1972.
3. Constitution of Board.‑(1) As soon as it
may fit the Government shall by a notification m the official Gazette
constitute a Board.
(2) The Board shall comprise of‑
(a) A Chairman, who shall be Secretary to the Government
of Baluchistan, Labour Department ;
(b) A member, who shall be :‑ .
(i) Secretaries to the Government of Baluchistan Education
and Financial Departments or their representatives not below the rank of a
Deputy Secretary ;
(ii) Director Labour Welfare Baluchistan ;
(iii) Three representatives from the workers ;
(iv) Three representatives from the employers contributing
the cess provided that the representatives from workers and employers shall be
nominated by the Government.
(v) Any person co‑opted by the Board for any
specific reason ;
(vi) Director Labour Welfare will be Secretary of the
Board.
4. Tenure of office of Member.‑(1) Official
member shall be permanent unless removed, replaces) by the Government. A non‑official
Member shall be nominated for a period of two years from the date of his
notification. The outgoing members shall, however, be eligible for re‑nomination;
Provided that an outgoing Member may continue in office
until the appointment of his successor is notified;
